spans.s: रंह् vt. or vi. 1P, 10U (pres. रंहति, रंहयति-ते) 1. To hasten, to move with speed, न ररंहाश्वकुंजरम् Bt.xiv.98; 2. to urge on, to cause to move or flow; 3. to speak.
रंहति f. Velocity, speed.
रंहस् n. 1. Speed, quickness, K.S.ii.63; 2. vehemence, violence, R.ii.34.
रंक (I) a. (f. का) 1. Mean, poor, miserable, hungry; 2. slow.
रंक (II) m. A beggar, a wretch, आत्तस्नाय्वन्त्रनेत्रः प्रकटितदशनः प्रेतरंकः करंकात् M.M.v.
रंक (I) a. (f. का) 1. Mean, poor, miserable, hungry; 2. slow.
रंकु m. A deer, an antelope.
रंग (I) m. 1. Colour, dye, hue; 2. the nasal modification of vowel, एवं रंगाः प्रयोक्तव्याः खेअराँ इव खेदया
Sik.26
; 3. a place of public amusement, a theatre, a stage, an arena, रतिक्षेत्रे रंगे प्रियपथिकसार्थैरनुगता Mrich.v.; 4. an audience, an assembly, अहो रागवद्वचितवृत्तिरालिखित इव सर्वतो रंगः Sak.i., S.
; 5. a field of battle; 6. dancing, acting, mirth; 7. borax.
रंग (II) m.n. Tin.
रंग-अंगण n. an amphitheatre, an arena.
रंग-अवतरण n. 1. entering on the stage; 2. the profession of an actor.
रंग-आजीव, -जीवक m. 1. a painter; 2. an actor.
रंग-आजीव, -जीवक m. 1. a painter; 2. an actor.
रंग-कार m. a painter.
रंग-चर m. 1. an actor; 2. a gladiator.
रंग-ज n. red lead.
रंग-देवता f. the goddess supposed to preside over sports and diversions.
रंग-द्वार n. 1. a stage-door; 2. the prologue of a play, S.
रंग-भूति f. the night of full-moon in the month of Āśvina.
रंग-भूमि f. 1. a stage, an arena; 2. a battle-field.
रंग-मंडप m. a theatre.
रंग-मातृ f. 1. lac-dye or the insect producing it; 2. a bawd.
रंग-वाट m. a place enclosed for contest, an arena.
रंग-शाला f. a playhouse, a dancing-hall.

रंज् vt. or vi. 1U, 4U (pp. रक्त; pres. रजति-ते, रज्यति-ते; pass. रज्यते) 1. To be coloured, to be dyed, to redden, Na.iii.120; 2. to dye, to colour, to tinge; 3. to be attached or devoted to, (with a loc.), निर्गुणानपि न द्वेष्टि न रजयति गुणेष्वपि S.D.iii.; 4. to be affected or excited, to feel passion for; 5. to be pleased or delighted with.With अनु-, 1. to redden; 2. to be fond of, to love, (with a loc.), M.iii.73; 3. to be attached, Bg.xi.36.With अप-, 1. to be discoloured, बिभ्रत्कांचनमेकमेव वलयं श्वासापरक्ताधरः Sak.vi.; 2. to become discontented with, (with an abl.), नयहीनादपरज्यते जनः Kir.ii.49.With उप-, 1. to be eclipsed, उपरज्यते किल भगवांश्चंद्र इति Mud.i.; 2. to be afflicted, to suffer calamity.With वि-, 1. to grow discoloured of soiled; 2. to be disinclined, to dislike, चिरानुरक्तोऽपि विरज्यते जनः Mrich.i., Bt.xviii.22; 3. to be disgusted with the world.

रंज् Caus. (रंजयति-ते) 1. to colour, to paint, to redden, च्रणौ रंजयंस्त्वस्याश्चूडामणिमरीचिभिः K.S.vi.81; 2. to gratify, to please, ज्ञानलवदुर्विदग्धं ब्रह्मापि नरं न रंजयति Bhartr.ii.3; 3. to conciliate, M.vii.19; 4. (रजयति) to hunt deer.
रंजक (I) m. 1. A painter; 2. a stimulus.
रंजक (II) n. 1. Red sandal; 2. vermilion.
रंजन n. 1. The act of colouring or painting; 2. colour, dye; 3. pleasing, delighting, gratifying, तथैव सोभूदन्वर्थो राजा प्रकृतिरंजनात् R.iv.12; 4. red sandal-wood.
रंजनी f. The Indigo plant.
रन्तु f. 1. A way, a road; 2. a river.
रंधन n. 1. The act of destroying; 2. of cooking.
रंधि f. 1. The act of destroying; 2. of cooking.

रंध्र n. 1. A hole, an aperture, an opening, a cavity, हंसद्वारं भृगुपतियशोवर्त्म यत्क्रौंचरंध्रम् Megh.i.57, R.xv.82; 2. a defect, a weak poiut, a fault, an imperfection, रंध्रान्वेषणदक्षाणां द्विषामामिषतां ययौ R.xii.11.
रंध्र-बभ्रु m. a rat.
रंध्र-वंश m. a hollow bamboo.
रांकव (I) a. (f. वी) Belonging to the ranku deer or made from its hair.
रांकव (II) n. A woollen cloth made of deer’s hair, a blanket.
रांकव (I) a. (f. वी) Belonging to the ranku deer or made from its hair.
रांभ m. A staff of bamboo carried by an ascetic.
